svg.aria-label: YouTube Summarizer: A 0.6B model watches YouTube so you don't have to. Qwen3-0.6B turns a link into notes: overview, key points in order, takeaway. Captions or local faster-whisper; long videos split into ≤2,048-token parts. Fine-tuning it and scoring faithfulness on a 50-transcript golden set (in progress). Stack: PyTorch, Hugging Face, FastAPI.
